locked_conventions.source_interval: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure and zero extension; the zero-Lebesgue-integral source normalization and full source Gram C^*C are retained
locked_conventions.physical_interval: I_lambda=[-log(lambda),log(lambda)] with Lebesgue measure in logarithmic coordinates, equivalently du/u on [lambda^(-1),lambda]
locked_conventions.prime_endpoint: every prime power n<=lambda^2 is included
locked_conventions.inversion: multiplicatively Jf(u)=f(u^(-1)); in the additive logarithmic coordinate Jf(x)=f(-x), and reflection is retained before forming the inversion-even state
locked_conventions.matched_schedule: lambda=p/2 for odd p>=5 and N=ceil(lambda^2)=(p^2+3)/4
locked_conventions.anchor_scope: p_4=a_4^(-1)*P_N*k_lambda^+ is nonzero eventually on the matched schedule; no finite p=5 or p=7 nonvanishing certificate is claimed
locked_conventions.positive_negative_split: C and R remain separate positive operators in B=g*I+C-R before C is shorted to the physical range
locked_conventions.artifact_scope: p and dps label deterministic matched-schedule metadata and doubled replay settings for exact rational theorem-regression models, not physical prolate-Weil pilot matrices
locked_conventions.arithmetic: all component regression matrices and reported reserves are exact reduced rationals; no binary64 parameter is accepted

locked_formulas.matched_anchor_limit: ||p_4||=a_4^(-1)*a_(lambda,N) tends to a_infty/a_4>=K_star/a_4>0 when log(lambda)/(N+1) tends to zero
locked_formulas.parity_split: even: C=T_a+2|p_+><p_+| and R=T_v; odd: C=T_a and R=T_v+2|p_-><p_-|
locked_formulas.leverage_density: kappa_H(t)=kappa_X(t)-mathcal_W(t)*G^dagger*mathcal_W(t)^*, G=W^*W and mathcal_W is the Fourier evaluation row
locked_formulas.scalar_gluing: eta=g-rho, chi^2=rho*beta/eta, and rho*beta<eta*mu imply B>=nu*(Delta direct-sum eta*I), nu=(mu+1-sqrt((mu-1)^2+4*chi^2))/2>0
locked_formulas.anisotropic_schur: gI-R_KK+C_/K-R_KH*(gI-R_HH)^(-1)*R_HK>0 is the sharper sufficient condition
locked_formulas.source_beta: for A=W*D^(-1/2) and Delta=(A*A^*)^dagger on K, beta=||A^*R*A||
